facets.description: RuleActionsButtons.V2: the Silence menu item is enabled from promRule abilities, but SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer only renders when the ruler `rule` exists (rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)). In the list view `rule` is undefined, so clicking Silence does nothing.

RuleActionsButtons.V2: the Duplicate menu item is enabled from promRule abilities, but the clone/duplicate redirect (RedirectToCloneRule) may still depend on the ruler `rule`. With only promRule available in the list view, Duplicate may do nothing.
